newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser says "stag" IDT IPO shares.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser says "stag" IDT IPO shares.

text.p: Singapore broking house Fraser Securities said on Tuesday it recommended investors to "stag" - subscribe but sell immediately on listing - shares offered by IDT Holdings (Singapore) in its initial public offer (IPO).
IDT, a unit of Hong Kong's IDT International, designs, makes and distributes liquid crystal display (LCD) electronic consumer products.
IDT is offering 22.08 million shares at US$0.73 each, with a placement tranche of 17.664 million shares. The IPO closes on January 23.
"As the issue is likely to be very well received on undemanding pricing and small public offer, we are calling a 'stag' on IDT Holdings (Singapore)," Fraser said in a circular.
The broking house said the shares offered at a historical price earnings (PE) of 9.6 times and forecast PE of 8.3 times, are among the more reasonably priced IPOs to come onto the Singapore market.

"They have also not exploited the higher PEs in Singapore as IDT International is trading in Hong Kong at about 8.4 times prospective PE. The PEs of previous share listings in Singapore last year were between seven and 15 times," said Fraser.
It said IDT's strong research and development capabilities, wide customer base and established relationships with suppliers and customers would contribute to its success.
However, IDT relied heavily on the LCD technology in the production of its products.
Investors should pay attention to China's political, economic, legal and social environment as IDT's manufacturing facilities are based entirely in Xixian in China, it said.
